A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the forest understory is a critical element for forest management in the tropics.
the advance regeneration in the forest understory plays the most important role for forest recovery and that the regeneration dynamic varies across topography and over the long term.
the advance regeneration in the forest understories of mixed dipterocarps in the Sinharja reserve is an important source of seedling recruitment that can be managed sustainably.
The main takeaway from our work is that
advance regeneration in the forest understory is the main source of new trees for the next forest.
the understory is a rich reservoir for the future of the forest and that it should be considered in any management plan for the forest.
the understory of tropical forests is not a homogeneous, static community of seedlings, but rather a dynamic community that varies in species composition, density, and mortality over time and space.
